annotations.title: Check, fix or render voxel art

description: Voxel art by the voxart kit rules (gb.use("voxart"): one locked palette of hue-shifted ramps, the rules every GrowBlocks voxel model is held to). file: a .vox (MagicaVoxel, Scenario Voxels, the toVox() of your generator) or the cells JSON of growblocks_blender voxelize with by "color" (a Meshy/Tripo GLB as voxels). op "check": score 0-100 and the issues (colours, floating pieces, glow share, symmetry for kind "character", speckle, thin tips, voxel budget, readability at 96 px). "fix": snaps to the palette, caps colours, drops floating bits, fills pinholes, cleans speckle (mirror left|right, size "64" or "48x64x32" to resample), writes <name>.fixed.vox. "render": the turnaround sheet. fix and render return the sheet image (front, side, top, three-quarter, 96 px thumb): look at it, change the generator or the options, run again.

colours.description: Most colours to keep (the style allows 24).

dir.description: The game folder (default: the folder the assistant runs in).
